verdict.rationale: The Graph docs show teams organized into channels: apps can create teams and channels, add the right people to a team, and configure it with channels, tabs and apps. Community posts confirm channels are a core part of how conversations are organized. Nothing in the pack separates public from private channels or describes channel-level membership controls for a team-admin; the only membership evidence is at the team level and via the API. Missing for 10: explicit public vs. private channel types, per-channel membership and permission controls for admins, admin UI documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.
